name: rot-dtd-commander
description: RoT DtD Commander: 68 Claude Code commands (the nine RoT MoE lenses as commands among them), 19 skills and 5 agents that carry their own DTD grammar and trust boundary, a guided NPX installer into ~/.claude, the Adiutor, a Stop-hook doctor that checks every -dtd answer against the DOCTYPE that produced it, and the Commander-Adiutor, a monitor that hands every failed answer to the session as the ledger closes it.

scripts.gate: npm run build:check && npm run check && node checker/heading-sweep.mjs --check && node checker/frontmatter-sweep.mjs --check && npm run controls && node checker/contract-audit.mjs && bash checker/checker-controls.sh && npm run sweep && npm run controls:ordinals && npm run controls:slop && npm run sweep:slop
scripts.sweep:slop: node lib/ai-slop.mjs sweep src/commands src/skills src/agents --max 18
